setup_cmd: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arduino/arduino-cli/master/install.sh | sudo BINDIR=/usr/local/bin sh && arduino-cli core install ch32-community:ch32v --additional-urls https://github.com/ch32-community/board_manager_files/raw/main/package_ch32v_index.json
build_cmd: CORE_DIR="$(arduino-cli config get directories.data)/packages/ch32-community/hardware/ch32v" && rm -rf "$CORE_DIR"/* && mkdir -p "$CORE_DIR/0.0.0" && rsync -a --exclude=.git --exclude=build ./ "$CORE_DIR/0.0.0/" && arduino-cli compile --fqbn ch32-community:ch32v:CH32V00x_EVT:dbg=enable_sym --build-path "$PWD/build/CH32V00x" libraries/Wire/examples/i2c_scanner
